title: Unit tests for session credential handling
description: Write automated unit tests to verify credentials are session-only and cleared on session end.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests verify credentials not persisted to storage
Unit tests verify credentials cleared on page refresh
Unit tests verify credentials cleared on page close

evidence: Test file: src/__tests__/useConnection.test.ts (17 tests, all passing)
- 'does not persist credentials to localStorage' (AC: credentials not persisted to storage)
- 'does not persist credentials to sessionStorage' (AC: credentials not persisted to storage)
- 'clears credentials when beforeunload fires (page refresh)' (AC: credentials cleared on page refresh)
- 'clears credentials when pagehide fires (page close / navigation away)' (AC: credentials cleared on page close)
- 'requires a new connection after session end' (AC: credentials cleared on session end)
Implementation: src/hooks/useConnection.ts (credentials held in React state only, cleared on beforeunload/pagehide)
